reviews.classification: unselected succession design and bounded historical source/reference review
reviews.disposition: Preserve B3-A01–B3-A23 (including A11a) as dated source/authority observations. Estate handover, kin label, parentage, taught mastery, power-composition lineage and a continued self are distinct. Current complete buildLifeHeirSave still creates fresh expansion and selected estate/history, but now explicitly calls carryCheats and preserves inheritance_law/discovery_codex. Selected complete carryCheats 117–165 has card-specific cross-life handling, so A16’s “does not explicitly copy previous cheats” and any blanket no-faculty-carry claim are stale. This closes that narrow absence, not generic soul/blood transmission or retained-world population/stock continuity. Old one-realm/prestige authority is retired; native defeat, old-age end and supported succession remain distinct. No current native/atomic crash-safe heir proof is added.
reviews.evidence: Complete original file read, including full design schema/acceptance and all five reference lenses. Current full life_experience_host.js and selected carryCheats function inspected for A16 drift; original proprietary dossiers/raw source/browser were not reread.
reviews.reopen: A selected succession/carrier consumer can reopen exact world/source/save questions; no current prestige milestone or all-legacy/human gate is imposed.

reviews.disposition: G30.01–G30.10 preserve declared transmission timing, immutable donor/child event versus later somatic training, separate concentration/function/memory/curse/standing/trial/estate carriers, funded escrow and useful heir action. The 0.8 coefficient, two functions, range 2/4, six-coin trial and practice minutes are illustrative, not biological/canon rules or mandatory weakening/caps. Stable person/body/time refs, frozen offers, idempotent successor settlement and unresolved escrow remain useful selected-consumer requirements. Old migration matrix is optional under current compatibility direction, current-state persistence/failure boundaries remain; G30-V1–V5 are unrun proposed checks and human review is optional. Retiring the milestone does not authorize G30 implementation.
